timingGuidance: Use for full-scene presenter beats where a transparent VP9-alpha cutout (speaker.webm) is hole-cut into the composition. Pair with an inverse-alpha plate (plate.webm) on track 0 so background layers, headlines, and overlays read above the subject. Typical beat is 5-10s.
usageRules: Wrap each <video> in a non-timed div; opacity/scale tweens target the wrapper, not the <video> element, because the runtime force-applies position:absolute and 100%x100% on tracked stage children.

Drop the subject cutout (speaker.webm) on a mid-to-high scene track and the inverse-alpha plate (plate.webm) on background track 0 so HTML headlines on intermediate tracks can sit behind the head and above the plate.
Generate speaker.webm and plate.webm with `bunx hyperframes remove-background <presenter>.mp4` — first-party path is HeyGen, but any presenter MP4 works (webcam, D-ID, Synthesia, Veo).
Do not commit speaker.webm or plate.webm. Push them to R2 and list them in assets.remote.json so `bun run hydrate:episode <slug> --manifest=assets` restores them.
Use `playsinline muted` on the <video> elements so the Chromium renderer auto-decodes alpha frames seek-safely; do NOT use `autoplay` or `loop`.
Treat the subject as a self-framed object — do not wrap it in a generic glass/card container.
